finalText: Build now exits 0. The real bug was in `src/core/settings.js:17` — `resolveConfig` referenced the bare identifier `retries` instead of `env.retries`, throwing a `ReferenceError` that aborted the link stage. Fixed it, and the build completes cleanly (`3 warnings, 0 errors`). The remaining 3 warnings (deprecated `crypto.createCipher`, an unused export, a circular import) are pre-existing lint-level notices, not build breakers — let me know if you want those cleaned up too.
